statement: Between 2026-08-16 and 2026-09-15, the Israeli government publicly reverses course and endorses the Trump-brokered Gaza peace framework it rejected on 2026-08-09, or a revised version of that framework.
resolution: At least two independent outlets (e.g. Reuters, AP, Al Jazeera, BBC) report an official Israeli government or Netanyahu statement endorsing the plan between 2026-08-16 and 2026-09-15.
failure_condition: No official Israeli government endorsement of the plan, original or revised, is reported during the window; the rejection stated on 2026-08-09 stands unreversed.

statement: On 2026-08-11, Francesca Hong places first in the Wisconsin Democratic gubernatorial primary among the four active candidates: Hong, David Crowley, Kelda Roys, and Joel Brennan.
resolution: Wisconsin Elections Commission results or an AP race call confirms Francesca Hong received the most votes in the 2026-08-11 Democratic gubernatorial primary.
failure_condition: Certified or AP-called results show a candidate other than Hong placed first, or no clear plurality winner emerges, from the 2026-08-11 primary.

statement: On 2026-08-11, the South Carolina Republican special primary for U.S. Senate fails to produce a majority winner among the nine-candidate field, triggering a runoff.
resolution: South Carolina State Election Commission certified results or an AP call confirms the vote share of the leading candidate was below 50 percent, requiring a runoff.
failure_condition: Certified or AP-called results show one candidate winning an outright majority on 2026-08-11, so no runoff is required.

statement: Between 2026-08-16 and 2026-09-15, the Yemen-based Houthi movement claims responsibility for a new attack on Saudi Arabian oil, gas, or energy infrastructure, separate from the 2026-08-09 Aramco refinery incident.
resolution: At least two independent outlets (e.g. Reuters, AP, Al Jazeera) report a Houthi-claimed attack on Saudi energy infrastructure occurring between 2026-08-16 and 2026-09-15.
failure_condition: No new Houthi-claimed attack on Saudi energy infrastructure is reported during the window.

statement: Between 2026-08-16 and 2026-09-15, at least one additional Russian missile, drone, or artillery strike on Odesa oblast, Ukraine is reported and corroborated by sources on both the Russian and Ukrainian sides.
resolution: At least two independently-biased public sources, one Russian-aligned and one Ukrainian-aligned, or two independent wire services, report a strike on Odesa oblast within the window.
failure_condition: No cross-corroborated report of a Russian strike on Odesa oblast appears during the window.

statement: At some daily close between 2026-08-16 and 2026-09-15, NYMEX WTI crude front-month futures settle at or above 85.00 dollars per barrel.
resolution: CME Group or EIA daily settlement data shows at least one NYMEX WTI front-month close at or above 85.00 dollars per barrel between 2026-08-16 and 2026-09-15.
failure_condition: No daily NYMEX WTI front-month close reaches 85.00 dollars per barrel at any point in the window.

statement: Between 2026-08-16 and 2026-10-15, Meta Platforms publishes a public retrospective or incident report on the Irregular-linked AI cybersecurity testing incident involving its Muse Spark model.
resolution: Meta issues a distinct public report, blog post, or statement specifically labeled as a retrospective or post-incident review of the Irregular testing incident within the window.
failure_condition: No distinct Meta retrospective or incident report on the Irregular testing matter is published during the window.

statement: Between 2026-08-09 and 2026-08-20, an Irish court grants Daniel Kinahan bail pending trial, rather than remanding him in custody at every hearing.
resolution: Irish Times, RTE, or Irish Examiner reporting confirms a court granted Kinahan bail at any hearing occurring in the window.
failure_condition: Kinahan is remanded in custody at every hearing in the window, or no bail application succeeds.

statement: Between 2026-08-09 and 2026-08-30, an earthquake of magnitude 5.5 or greater occurs within 150 km of the 2026-08-09 M6.3 Sarangani, Philippines mainshock.
resolution: The USGS ANSS Comcat catalog lists an event of magnitude 5.5 or greater within 150 km of the mainshock epicenter, timestamped within the window.
failure_condition: No magnitude 5.5 or greater event within 150 km of the mainshock appears in the USGS catalog during the window.

statement: The Form 10-Q filed by Berkshire Hathaway for the quarter ended 2026-09-30 reports cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments below 365.5 billion dollars, continuing the Q2 decline.
resolution: The Form 10-Q filed on SEC EDGAR by Berkshire Hathaway for the quarter ended 2026-09-30, filed between 2026-10-01 and 2026-11-10, shows cash and equivalents under 365.5 billion dollars.
failure_condition: The Q3 2026 10-Q reports cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments at or above 365.5 billion dollars.
